models.name: Dory 1.0 4B
models.why: NVIDIA's looped-architecture 4B model; 256K context held entirely in VRAM on a 12GB RTX 3060 (38 tok/s without the -ot tensor placement, ~50 with it)

engines.quant: Q5_K_M, 262,144-token context, Q8 KV cache (Q8_0 keys/values), two loops with last-loop recurrent KV cache, -ot 'blk.(scale|alpha).=CUDA0,token_embd.*=CUDA0'
engines.engine_min_version: requires llama.cpp change llama.cpp#30306 (not yet upstream); run via llama-server
